Notification of Cellular Mobile Phones under Clause 3(a) of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 vide notification of even number dated 29.04.2020 The Government has issued Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 [PPP-MIi Order 2017] vide Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Order No.P-45021/2/2017-B.E . -11 dated 15.06.2017 and subsequent revisions vide Order No.45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II) dated 28.05.2018, 29.05.2019, 04.06.2020 and 16.09.2020 to encourage 'Make in India' and to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India with a vi ew to enhance income and employment. 2. The Clause 3(a) of the revised Order states that "In procurement of all goods, services or works in respect of which the Nodal Ministry / Department has communicated that there is sufficient local capacity and local competition, only 'Class-I local supplier', as defined under the PPP-MIi Order 2017 dated 16.09.2020, shall be eligible to bid irrespective of purchase value." Cont...2/- -- 1 of 6 -- -2- 3. As per the PPP-MIi Order 2017 dated 16.09.2020, the Class-I local supplier means that the local content requirement is minimum 50%. 4 . Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) is the Nodal Ministry under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 for electronic goods. 5. With regard to Clause 3(a) of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 , after due stakeholder consultation, it has been inferred that sufficient local capacity and local competition is available for Cellular Mobile Phones. Therefore, henceforth, procuring entities shall procure Cellular Mobile Phones only from Class-I local suppliers, irrespective of purchase value. Local content shall be calculated as prescribed vide MeitY Notification No.W-43/4/2019-IPHW-MeitY dated 07.09 .2020. Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade Order No. No.P45021/2/2017-B. E.-11 dated 15.06.2017 and its revisions dated 28.05.2018 and 29.05.2019 2. Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Notification No.33(5)/2017-IPHW dated 01.08.2018 for Cellular Mobile Phones The Government has issued Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 vide Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Order No.P-45021 /2/2017-B.E.-11 dated 15.06.2017 and subsequent revisions vide Order No.45021/2/2017-PP (BE- II ) dated 28.05.2018 and 29.05 .2019 to encourage 'Make in India' and to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India with a view to enhancing income and employment. 2 . The Clause 3(a) of the aforesaid Order, inter-alia , states that " In procurement of all goods, services or works in respect of which the estimated value of procurement is less than INR 50 lakhs, only local suppliers shall be eligible to bid. However, in procurement of all goods, services or works, in respect of which the Nodal Ministry/ Department has communicated that there is sufficient local capacity and local competition, only local suppliers shall be eligible to bid irrespective of purchase value. Provided that for any particular ·item, the Nodal Ministry / Department may also prescribe an upper threshold limit, below which procurement shall be made only from local suppliers." 3. Ministry of Electronics and Informati on Technology (MeitY) is the Nodal Ministry under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 for electronic goods.
